projectDescription: A reproducible R-based meta-analysis pipeline investigating the global prevalence of inappropriate acid suppressing agent (proton pump inhibitor) prescribing, with subgroup analyses, meta-regression, and publication bias assessment.
keyFeatures: Reproducible targets-based R pipeline with parallel execution via crew
Random-effects meta-analysis using Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation
Subgroup analyses across age, continent, setting, study quality, and guideline use
Univariable and multivariable meta-regression with REML estimation
Publication bias assessment via Copas selection model and Doi plots
publicApiSurface: fitMetaprop(tbl, ...) — Fit random-effects meta-analysis for proportion data
fitMetareg(tbl, varname, ...) — Fit univariable or multivariable meta-regression
applyCopas(obj, varname, ...) — Apply Copas selection model for publication bias
clean(tbl, ...) — Standardize and harmonize raw study-level variables
readData(fpath, ...) — Read CSV data into tidy data frame
lsData(path, ...) — List raw data files in a directory
